name: Fresh Splashes
summary: Swaps the yellow lines on the title screen for a few hundred brand-new ones about blocks, mobs, caves and crafting.
logoPrompt: A tilted, glowing yellow speech bubble made of blocky voxels bursting out of a grass block, with small yellow sparkles around it, centred, in blocky voxel style, no text

cover.tagline: New lines for your title screen.

description: **Fresh Splashes gives the yellow line on the title screen 300 new things to say, all written for this pack.**
- 300 new splash texts about mining, mobs, crafting, building, farming, redstone and exploring.
- Little tips hide among the jokes, like bringing doors to an ocean monument.
- Short lines that stay easy to read next to the logo.
- Family-friendly and original: no line is copied from the game's own list.
Put the zip into the `resourcepacks` folder of your game, then turn it on under Options > Resource Packs. A new splash appears each time you return to the title screen.
- A resource pack for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3. It changes nothing in your worlds.
- It replaces the vanilla splash list, so the original splashes do not appear while the pack is on. Turn it off to get them back.
- The game's own greetings on Christmas Eve, New Year's Day and Halloween still show up.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea for a splash? Leave a comment.
